description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md/SETUP.md to learn that codex-quota.py reads from ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/*.jsonl files, looking for 'token_count' events containing a 'rate_limits' object. 2. Agent inspects the existing session files: the old file (5 days ago) has a token_count event with NO rate_limits key; the mid-age file (1 day ago) has stale near-maxed values (used=9999/49999). 3. Agent creates a NEW session JSONL file under ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/ (today's date) containing at least one 'token_count' event with a valid 'rate_limits' object having 'primary' and 'secondary' sub-objects each with 'used', 'limit', and 'reset_at' fields. 4. Agent runs: python3 /workspace/codex-quota/codex-quota.py --json > /workspace/quota_report.json (or equivalent). 5. The resulting quota_report.json must contain the keys: source_file, file_age_minutes, primary_window, secondary_window — exactly as produced by the --json flag of codex-quota.py — and must NOT reflect the stale 9999/49999 values.
